text: AI is changing the workplace in many ways. One important change is automation, where machines or software do tasks that people used to do, such as handling data or answering customer questions. Companies also use productivity tools powered by AI to help workers save time and focus on bigger tasks. Many experts believe the future is not about AI replacing humans, but about human-AI collaboration, where people and machines work together. However, some jobs will change or even disappear, so workers need to learn new skills. In short, AI brings both opportunities and challenges to the modern workplace.
